items.caption:
Dream about falling meaning: what science says.
About 74% of 1,181 students had dreamed of falling at least once. Separately, a falling feeling can come with the hypnic jerk, the jolt 60 to 70% of people report as they drift off.

items.caption:
Some people punch their partner in their dreams.
In REM sleep behaviour disorder the body acts out dreams. In a large study, 73.5% developed Parkinson's or a related disorder within 12 years (Postuma et al., 2019).
